Dessa is a multifaceted recording artist known for her versatility and innovation in the world of music. She has a new project called “Bury the Lede” that displays this versatility up front. This Minneapolis, Minnesota artist has made a significant impact on the hip-hop and indie music scenes. Her latest album offers what you would expect: thought-provoking and emotionally charged lyrics that often explore themes of love, identity and the human experience. With a captivating stage presence and a voice that can seamlessly shift between rapping and singing, she showcases this superpower all throughout her latest single “Decoy”.

Dessa has garnered a dedicated following and earned critical acclaim for her boundary-pushing approach to music, making her a respected and influential figure in the contemporary music scene. On this latest project, Dessa continues to expose her thoughts on life, love and relationships all without burying the lede.

This interview was originally posted on HYFIN in October 2022.
